description: This file defines a SwiftUI view displaying agent events, including event rows with formatted JSON data, and provides a preview with sample data. It interacts with an external event store and control agent event data structures.

classes.name: EventRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single event row displaying event details and JSON data.

methods.name: formattedTs
methods.description: Formats the event's timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: prettyJSON
methods.description: Converts event data dictionary into a pretty-printed JSON string.
